## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the problem, actors, in-scope behavior, and out-of-scope behavior explicitly defined? [Completeness, Scope]
- [ ] CHK002 Are acceptance criteria specific and objectively verifiable? [Acceptance Criteria]
- [ ] CHK003 Are edge cases, retry paths, and failure modes addressed or marked N/A with a reason? [Coverage]

## Security And Data Quality

- [ ] CHK004 Are auth, authorization/RBAC, RLS, exposed-data, and deny-by-default requirements specified or marked N/A with a reason? [Security]
- [ ] CHK005 Are secret-handling requirements documented without including real secrets or sensitive values? [Secrets]
- [ ] CHK006 Are persistence, migration, rollback, and DB-test requirements specified when data changes are in scope? [Database]

## Billing, Infrastructure, And Production

- [ ] CHK007 Are billing/payment requirements explicit about money state, idempotency, duplicate events, retries, partial/full payment, and audit when applicable? [Billing/Payments]
- [ ] CHK008 Are MikroTik/RouterOS/worker requirements explicit about read-only vs write, dry-run, commit gate, retry/error handling, and audit when applicable? [Infrastructure]
- [ ] CHK009 Are local, staging, production, restore, and provider-sandbox evidence requirements distinguished clearly? [Production Evidence]
- [ ] CHK010 Are EXTERNAL_BLOCKED items limited to unavailable external evidence and never used for deterministic local tests? [External Evidence]

## Validation And Compatibility

- [ ] CHK011 Are required validation suites and CI gates named according to the feature impact? [Validation]
- [ ] CHK012 Are backwards-compatibility requirements defined for existing APIs, data contracts, user workflows, and operator runbooks? [Compatibility]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments, `N/A: <reason>`, or `EXTERNAL_BLOCKED: <evidence needed>` inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
